pattern: UUPS proxy (ERC1967). Proxy addresses are permanent.
registryUpgradeNote: Event-based Foskaay GGI Midchain functions added (additive, no storage change). Proxy unchanged.
coreNote: v7 single core (SessionRegistry, fee built in, single 0.0004 fee; batching lowers gas only). Upgraded in place; address unchanged. Ludo is behind a UUPS proxy (upgradeable).
demoNote: Ludo demo: FoskaayGGIDemoGames (all demo games, gameTag ludo) + FoskaayGGIDemoPlayer (one player account, per-game point buckets). Both UUPS, OZ-only, wired.
demoUpgradeNote: In-place UUPS upgrade of the permanent demo proxies (same addresses). Top-level layout unchanged.
foskaayGGINote: Phase 1: FRESH core, the SessionRegistry renamed to the locked FoskaayGGI, still a UUPS proxy (new permanent address) and still OpenZeppelin only. Adds the 3-part session fee (0.0004 base + 0.0004 per lifted account + 0.0002 per game) and handoverWithAccounts(games). Legacy single-fee handover/handoverMany are unchanged. version = 2, append-only __gap. The demo game FoskaayGGILudo is untouched (Phase 2 replaces it with FoskaayGGIGames + FoskaayGGIPlayers).

foskaayGGIFees.note: Native USDC wei (18 decimals). Base + per-account are charged once per session; only per-game grows with batching.

foskaayGGIGamesPlayersNote: Phase 2: FRESH Ludo game (FoskaayGGIGames: holds the match on-chain + the pure rules + settle(games[]) which credits the player in the same step) and FRESH player account (FoskaayGGIPlayers: per player, per game tag points/lives/records; credit callable only by its game). Both UUPS, OpenZeppelin only, permanent. Wired: players.game = games, games.players = players. The old demo FoskaayGGILudo (pure rules only) stays deployed untouched until the frontend moves to the new contracts in Phase 5.
foskaayGGIGamesUpgradeNote: LOGIC-ONLY UUPS upgrade in place (same proxy 0x24e38ac2e80958782a8Bc5CD479bbe2e5D81EcDF, same data; version stays 1). FIXED the finish/crown rule: _recordFinish counted any token >= 57, but a token in the yard is stored as 0xFF (255), so yard tokens were counted as home and a seat was crowned while it still had tokens in its base. A token is now home only when it is exactly 57 (never YARD). Verified on-chain after the upgrade: yard scenario finishCount = 0, all-four-home scenario finishCount = 1; players() and version() unchanged. New forge regression tests: testYardTokensAreNeverCountedAsFinished, testAllFourHomeRecordsFinish.
destinationNote: Fee tracking wallet (separate from the sponsor/deployer). setDestination on 2026-09-28 so session fees are trackable.

foskaayGGIGamesRecordUpgrade.note: Test1c (testnet only, mainnet untouched): settle now also calls addRecord per earning seat in the SAME transaction (played/wins/best). Crown record without new tx. Same proxy, same address, same data. Upgrade visible as Upgraded event on the proxy.

foskaayGGIGamesIndexUpgrade.note: Persistent-gameplay upgrade (version 2): append-only per-player game index (playerGameIndices) + playerGamesOf/gamesOf getters + setVersion. Same address, same data; version + us (append-only storage after __gap).

foskaayGGILiveBoardUpgrade.note: Live-board store (recordLive/liveBoard): each move's board bytes commit to FoskaayGGIGames so any device reconstructs/rejoins the exact mid-game state from the chain (GFG board-PDA equivalent). Moves are computed free via eth_call; the per-move record is a tiny sponsor tx.

foskaayGGIMidchainFeeFix.note: Per-move Arc recordLive write REMOVED (it was a forbidden third transaction). The Foskaay GGI midchain is the signed off-chain hash chain (eth_call + signature + hash chain), anchored by Handover and Settle: exactly two Arc txs per session. The freely deployed v3 liveBoards storage stays unused, costs nothing, and is never written during play.

ludoMp.note: Isolated multiplayer copy for gfgnew/board/ludo-mp (testnet only until proven; single-player untouched). GFGGames + GFGPlayers, both UUPS proxies, wired (players.game = games, games.players = players). Future features are upgrades, never new addresses.

v4TimerUpgrade.note: Contract-owned turn timer (approved): turnSecs 45 + maxMatchSecs 3600 constants, turnDeadline/isTurnExpired views, settle verifies move timestamps (monotonic, turn window + grace, match cap, not future). Same proxies, same data (old committed games still read).

v4TimerFix.note: Clock-sketch hardening: handover-anchored moveTss[0], chain-anchored relay timestamps (never ahead of head, never below previous), 120s future tolerance for testnet head jitter. Same proxies, same data.
